headline: Proposed no-parking rules on Hanover Street and a request to stripe three parking spaces on Maple Street.
summary: Two no-parking changes on Hanover Street are up for review, including one limited to school-day morning unloading. Keach-Nordstrom Associaties asks for approval to stripe three parallel parking spaces on Maple Street for Three NH Guys LLC.
items: No parking anytime on Hanover Street, south side, from Lincoln Street to a point 100 feet west (Alderman Fajardo)
No parking, active unloading only 7:30 AM to 9:00 AM, school days, on Hanover Street, north side, from Michigan Avenue to Beaver Street (Alderman Fajardo)
Request from Keach-Nordstrom Associaties for Three NH Guys LLC to stripe three parallel parking spaces in the Maple Street public right-of-way
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON PUBLIC SAFETY, HEALTH & TRAFFIC 
December 1, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Vincent, Goonan, Dexter, Barry, Bonilla 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. The Traffic Division has submitted an agenda which needs to be addressed: 
NO PARKING ANYTIME 
On Hanover Street, south side, from Lincoln Street to a point 100 feet west 
Alderman Fajardo 
NO PARKING ACTIVE UNLOADING ONLY 7:30AM – 9:00 AM, SCHOOL 
DAYS 
On Hanover Street, north side, from Michigan Avenue to Beaver Street 
Alderman Fajardo 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
2. Communication from Keach-Nordstrom Associaties on behalf of Three NH Guys 
LLC, requesting approval to stripe three (3) parallel parking spaces located 
within the Maple Street public right-of-way. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
